newsitem.title: USA: Mobil sets Arizona property stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Mobil sets Arizona property stake sale.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Friday it gave Crescent Real Estate Equities Co an option to purchase Mobil's 50-percent interest in Desert Mountain Properties.
Closing for the sale is expected by the end of August, the company said, noting concluding the sale "will complete our exit from the real estate business.

Desert Mountain, located in Scottsdale, Ariz., is an 8,000-acre residential and recreational community, which includes four 18-hole signature Jack Nicklaus golf courses and a world-class tennis, swim and fitness center. It is a joint venture development between Mobil and a Lyle Anderson company.

Mobil, in 1996, sold its community development business in seven states to Westbrook Partners LLC., the Reston Town Center, a 20-acre commercial development to Equity Office Holdings, LLC., and the Hyatt Regency Hotel at Reston to an affiliate of the Blackstone Real Estate Group.
